MIND. [1] [Carb. ac.]
Constantly agitated, moaning continuously and occasionally uttering a piercing cry ; recognizes no one. θ Acute hydrocephalus.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Carb. ac.]
Dull frontal headache in centre of forehead.
Feeling of tightness across forehead, directly above frontal sinuses.
Dull frontal headache, as if an india-rubber band was stretched tightly over forehead, from temple to temple.
Dull, heavy pain through temples, with tight band across forehead, and tightness in nose between eyes.
Head felt as if enclosed in a band, which at times seemed to compress and crush in head, < in temples.
Head feels very heavy.
Congestive headache.
Basilar meningitis ; acute hydrocephalus.
Periodical spells of sick headache, about time of catamenia.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Carb. ac.]
Tinea capitis ; vermin on head ; itching of scalp.
Cold clammy moisture on head.
Retraction of head. θ Hydrocephalus
Small pustulous vesicle a little to left of vertex.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Carb. ac.]
Sensitive to light ; headache.
Alternate contraction and dilatation of pupils. θ Hydrocephalus.
Very severe orbital neuralgia over right eye.
Neuralgia of right eye and temple.
Slight pain over right eyebrow ; the same kind of pain, but in a milder degree, under right patella ; both of short duration.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Carb. ac.]
Smell more acute.
Watery discharge from both nostrils, in open air, > indoors, returning when entering a cold room. θ Coryza.
Fetid discharge from nose. θ Diphtheria.
Nasal membrane so tumefied, must breathe through mouth. θ Scarlatina.
Nasal catarrh, ozæna, discharge very offensive.
Epithelioma on nose.
A small vesicle formed on centre of nose.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Carb. ac.]
Face sensitive to touch of towel.
Face flushed and burns. θ Headache.
Face pale ; and anxious.
White circle around mouth, rest of face dusky red. θ Scarlatina.
Sallow, soapy and bloodless complexion.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Carb. ac.]
Lips dry, cracked, painful or black. θ Scarlatina.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Carb. ac.]
Aching of teeth of right upper jaw. θ Toothache.
Grinding of teeth. θ Hydrocephaloid.
Sordes.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Carb. ac.]
Tongue dry and chippy ; parched and fissured.
Tongue : white ; dark brown ; thick, yellow white fur down centre (scarlatina) ; red papillæ project here and there ; shiny, glossy, dry coating ; covered with thick yellow fur.
Tongue dark brown coat, sordes. θ Remittent autumnal fever.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Carb. ac.]
Thrush, aphthæ, stomatitis.
Mouth and tongue black, sordes and ulcerated patches on inside of lips and cheeks. θ Scarlatina.
Intensely bad smell from mouth. θ Diphtheria. θ Scarlatina. θ Constipation.
Breath fetid and repulsive. θ Scarlatina.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Carb. ac.]
Fauces fiery red, swollen ; diphtheritic patches ; breath almost unbearable. θ Scarlatina.
Liquids, on being swallowed, return by nose. θ Scarlatina.
Burning in throat and œsophagus, with heat, rising up from stomach.
Fauces covered with exudate, glands of neck swollen, aphonia, croup-like cough, fetid discharge from nose, violent fever, pulse 130. θ Diphtheria.
Spasmodic contraction of œsophagus.
Mucous membrane of œsophagus dry, brownish, shrunken.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Carb. ac.]
Loss of all appetite.
Excessive thirst.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Carb. ac.]
While eating a little breakfast, felt every now and then as if he had to get up and vomit.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Carb. ac.]
Constant belching up of wind from stomach. θ Constipation.
Acid eructations and formation of gas.
Vomiting. θ Pregnancy. θ Seasickness. Cancer.
Vomiting ; of drunkards ; vomits everything taken into stomach. θ Bright's disease.
Chronic vomiting, sarcinæ in vomit.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Carb. ac.]
Burning in stomach.
Soreness in stomach and bowels.
A great deal of pain changing about from stomach to sides, especially right side and chest.
Dyspepsia ; aching in stomach ; diarrhœa, followed by constipation ; colicky pains.
Cancer of stomach.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Carb. ac.]
Pain in right hypochondrium ; also in iliac region of both sides.
Sharp pain in right hypochonder. θ Remittent autumnal fever.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Carb. ac.]
Rumbling and rolling in abdomen, with a sense of distention.
Frequent occurrence of colic-like pains.
Colic of nursing infants.
Great tenderness over transverse colon.
Bowels feel sore, when walking.
Flatulence of old age depending on imperfect digestion.
Abdomen retracted, with constipation. θ Hydrocephalus.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Carb. ac.]
Flatulence of old people. θ Dyspepsia.
Fetid odor.
Bloody and mucous discharge, appearing like scraping of mucous membrane ; tenesmus. θ Dysentery.
Involuntary thin, black stools. θ Collapse.
Involuntary stools of intolerable odor. θ Puerperal fever.
Diarrhœa, with vomiting of everything taken ; desire to drink ; rice-water discharge of very offensive odor, resembling that of rotten eggs. θ Summer complaint.
Diarrhœa, resulting from bad drainage.
Dysentery : bloody, mucous stools, like scrapings ; tenesmus ; tenderness over transverse colon ; tongue dry and coated with thick, yellow fur ; great thirst and high fever ; pulse 110.
Periodical spells of diarrhœa, followed by constipation. θ Hydrocephalus.
Constipation.
Sluggishness of bowels, accompanied by offensive breath.
Hemorrhoids, with tenderness of rectum, also external, sometimes bleeding.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Carb. ac.]
A dark greenish-brown color of urine.
Greenish urine. θ After scarlatina.
Urine scanty and red. θ Scarlatina.
Urine : golden yellow ; grass or olive green ; very dark colored ; black or blackish olive green.
Frequent micturition.
Micturated freely an excessive quantity of saccharine urine ; obliged to void urine three times every night, and no less than a pint each time ; greatly debilitated thereby. θ Diabetes.
Urine contained albumen ; t. θ Meningitis.
While urinating always an involuntary mucous discharge from anus.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Carb. ac.]
Pain in region of left ovary, when walking in open air, soon subsiding.
Painful swelling of left ovary. θ Remittent autumnal fever.
Menses irregular.
Menses too profuse, dark color, followed by headache and great nervous irritability.
Menorrhagia : sinking spells, during which she thought she would die, with cold clammy skin, sallow, soapy, bloodless complexion, irritability of stomach, food lies heavy, flatulence, sour belching, fulness in throat, swollen feeling ; constant disposition to swallow, globus hystericus ; alternate diarrhœa and constipation.
Induration of cervix uteri.
Ulceration on cervix uteri ; < after caustics, discharge of fetid, greenish, acrid matter from vagina ; < after menstruation, which was profuse and lasted six to eight days.
Mucous tubercles on labia and inner thighs, with vaginal discharge.
Copious discharge of fetid, greenish, acrid matter from vagina. θ Leucorrhœa.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Carb. ac.]
Vomiting in pregnancy ; great irritability ; violent frontal headache.
Puerperal fever ; high fever alternating with often recurring chills of short duration, followed by profuse sweat with restlessness ; tenderness over uterus and right iliac fossa ; pulse 160 ; diarrhœa, involuntary stools of intolerable odor ; lochia suppressed ; craving for food ; thirst.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Carb. ac.]
Aphonia.
Diphtheria.
Catarrhal croup.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Carb. ac.]
Stertorous respiration.
Desire to take long inspirations, with yawning.
Shortness of breath on going up hill or up-stairs.
   

COUGH. [27] [Carb. ac.]
Short, dry, hacking cough, with tickling in throat ; can hardly retain anything on stomach.
Croup-like cough. θ Diphtheria.
Whooping cough, with redness of face, watering of eyes and frontal headache.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Carb. ac.]
Slight uneasy pains in right lung.
Feeling of narrowness in chest, as if diaphragm depressed lungs.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Carb. ac.]
Bellow murmur over mitral valves ; dyspnœa and palpitation, < at night ; heart < after indiscretion in eating ; must walk very slow on account of heart beating, is exhausted by ascending. θ Organic valvular heart disease, consequent upon inflammatory rheumatism eight years previously.
Violent fever, pulse 130. θ Diphtheria.
Pulse irregular. θ Hydrocephaloid.
Pulse 160. θ Puerperal fever.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Carb. ac.]
Scirrhous cancer of left breast. Carb. ac., 2d dec., every two hours for two years.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Carb. ac.]
Neck very stiff and sore ; feels as if he had taken a bad cold. θ Remittent fever.
Glands of neck swollen. θ Diphtheria.
Severe pain in lumbo-sacral region, mostly during latter part of night, of long standing.
Soreness of muscles of back and limbs.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Carb. ac.]
Pains in right shoulder without suffering from moving arm.
Aching pains in left shoulder, like a toothache, when lying on right side.
Severe rheumatic pains in right shoulder ; feeling as though it would be impossible to raise arm, but when effort was made it aggravated pain but very little. θ Rheumatism.
Soreness of muscles of right arm.
Aching pain in left forearm.
Constant tired, heavy feeling in left arm.
Twitching of arms, principally right ; t. θ Meningitis.
Slight lividity of finger tips.
Vesicular eruption on hands and all over body, which itches excessively ; > after rubbing, but leaving a burning pain.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Carb. ac.]
Rheumatic pain in right hip joint.
Aching soreness beneath left patella, all day up to about 4 o'clock P. M. ; feels as if it would be stiff and sore to move it, but is not felt at all.
Lower extremities feel heavy as lead.
Paralysis of lower extremities ; t. θ Meningitis.
Sharp pain in left shin.
Aching pain to left of middle of left shin bone.
Carbuncle on hip of lady, æt. 50.
Œdema of both legs ; t. θ Meningitis.
Chronic ulcers on feet and ankles, deep, emitting a strong odor and burning like fire.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Carb. ac.]
Numb ache in arms and legs. θ Remittent fever.
Stiffness of limbs. θ Hydrocephaloid.
   

NERVES. [36] [Carb. ac.]
Trembling, uncertain, straggling walk.
Partial convulsive movements. θ Hydrocephaloid.
Easily fatigued by least walk.
Complains of feeling very tired, even while lying in bed. θ Remittent fever.
Feels as if he had taken a bad cold. θ Remittent fever.
General malaise, great languor and weakness.
Profound prostration ; physical exhaustion ; surface pale, bathed in cold sweat ; collapse.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Carb. ac.]
Constant inclination to yawn, languid and sleepy, desire to stretch.
Sleeps uneasily, starts ; eyes half closed. θ Scarlatina.
Wakes often during night.
Dreams : unable to recall ; of fire ; amorous ; of traveling.
   

FEVER. [40] [Carb. ac.]
Chill, followed by fever and very slight sweat, with numb ache in arms and legs ; pulse small and rapid ; < about sundown and through night ; felt as if he had taken a bad cold.
High fever, alternating with often recurring chills of short duration, followed by profuse sweat, with restlessness. θ Puerperal fever.
Remittent fever, occurring every autumn.
Intermittent fever, with enlargement of spleen.
Scarlet fever.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Carb. ac.]
Affected right side first and afterwards same parts of left. θ Remittent fever.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Carb. ac.]
Putrid discharges from mouth, throat, nostrils, ears, rectum and vagina.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Carb. ac.]
Extensive scald (in glycerine externally).
Burns, especially if they ulcerate and discharge is offensive.
Lacerated wounds from blunt instruments ; bones bare or crushed and splintered.
   

SKIN. [46] [Carb. ac.]
Offensive odor from skin.
Eruption not diffused equitably over entire surface, interrupted in many places, and of a dusky red color. θ Scarlatina.
Malignant forms of scarlatina.
Confluent variola.
Acne, eczema, impetigo, scabies, psoriasis inveterata, leprosy ; prurigo ; pityriasis versicolor ; lupus, carbuncles and cancerous sores ; sloughing wounds ; chronic ulcers.
Ulcers with foul odor.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Carb. ac.]
Two children, 9 months old. θ Summer complaint.
Lady ; æt. 18 ; variola.
Miss, æt. 19 ; hysterical vomiting.
Young lady, æt 21 ; variola.
Woman, æt 39 ; dyspepsia.
Woman, æt. 46, scrofulous diathesis ; chronic ulcers on feet and ankles.
Woman, æt. 50 ; carbuncle on hip.
